market_summary: US stocks slipped Tue Nov 10 after a hot October CPI: headline +0.4% m/m (0.3% expected), core +0.3% (0.2% expected); S&P 500 -0.38%, Nasdaq -0.74%. The 10-yr rose about 9bp to 4.99% and briefly topped 5%; a 25bp December hike is now fully priced, with about 14% odds of 50bp after Waller floated a bigger step. Semis split: NVDA -5.5% on the board probe while AMD +7.3%, AVGO +7.9% and LRCX +8.5% rose. After the close CoreWeave beat (revenue +168%, backlog $132.5B), held 2026 capex at $37-39B and said it will not issue more parent unsecured debt at current yields; CRWV rose about 8% after hours and Nasdaq futures firmed. Brent fell 1.2% to $91.49 on Iran de-escalation talk, and the Hang Seng drifted lower, with tech down and data-centre generator names up.
